provider_message: Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model.
failed_attempt_handling: Retain as a missing observation, with its tools/probes; do not replace or score it as zero.
next_dispatch_gate: First wait for the two already-running reviews and require both to complete normally with valid evidence; check the entire condition for any policy/resource stop. Then run only the next previously unattempted row from the original frozen schedule, with its unchanged prompt, model, effort, source and full budget.
further_dispatch_gate: If that scheduled review completes normally and validates, resume the remaining original queue at three workers. Another capacity failure stops work for an availability decision; any policy or resource stop also stops new model phases.
grading_gate_departure: If remaining dispatch completes cleanly, grade completed valid reports with the original allow-gaps mode. This relaxes the prepared control plan requirement for all52 valid reports only for the preserved infrastructure gap. Never change eligibility or turn missing results into zeros.
comparison_rule_unchanged: A project needs two scored runs per arm. The incomplete detailed pulldown-cmark cell is excluded from the primary paired effect; its available grades remain reported. No replacement effect is computed.
